$comment: Which of the six promotion layers are generated and which are authored. Two come from the graph, one is translated, and three are things a graph structurally cannot carry — which is exactly what separates a script from something a firm can warrant.

layers.from: input nodes — already named and typed
node sequence read as dependency order

layers.why: graphs half-succeed by design and report it in a warning nobody reads
a graph run by a human HAS a human as its guard. Remove the human and you must replace them
if you cannot write the acceptance test, the graph has not earned promotion, whatever its run count says
